description: Check a social post against one platform's real character limit and report whether it fits. Returns the counted length, the limit, and what drove the count (URLs billed at a fixed width, non-Latin characters billed double, emoji sequences collapsed to one grapheme). Use this before publishing anything with a hard limit — the counting rules are per-platform and are not text.length.

platform.description: Which platform's rules to apply: x, x_premium, bluesky, linkedin, threads, mastodon, discord.

text.description: The post text, exactly as it will be published. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed, as the platforms do. `[URL]`-style placeholders are priced as a real link.

name: check_post
